edges: In the 60s, cars served as a place for conversation, music, and the open road.
The concept of a car phone was not part of the 1960s era.
The 1960s were a time of revolution and change, but technology was still catching up.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The technology required for car phones did not become feasible until much later.
The thought of a car phone in the 1960s would have seemed as outlandish as a man on the moon.
The existence of car phones in the 1960s contradicts the timeline of innovation.
